accepted_degree_fields.note: SPO § 2 Abs. 1: a first degree 'im Umfang von mindestens 210 ECTS-Punkten aus dem Bereich' Robotik, Mechatronik, Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik, Wirtschaftsingenieur, Produktionsingenieur, Regelungstechnik, Informatik, Elektronik, Bioinformatik, Gesundheitsinformatik, Automatisierungstechnik or a related/equivalent degree; 'Über die Gleichwertigkeit der Abschlüsse entscheidet die Prüfungskommission.' grade_requirement.note: No grade limit for access. subject_credit_requirements.note: No subject credit requirements in the SPO. conditional_admission.mechanism: No Auflagen for missing subject competences. SPO § 5 only covers degrees with at least 180 but fewer than 210 ECTS: the missing ECTS (max. 30) must be proven by the start of the third semester (internship of at least 20 weeks or relevant undergraduate courses of the university) as a condition for passing the Masterprüfung — a total-credit rule, not a subject condition (lesson 8).

Waiver possible (Prüfungskommission 'kann'): degree grade 'gut' (<2,5) or better, or grade 2,5 or better in Mathematik, Regelungstechnik, Physik, Informatik and Mechatronik or Robotik (SPO § 8 Abs. 2).
Specialisation (Intelligent Robotics or Assistive Robotics) must be chosen in the application; no entitlement that a specialisation runs (SPO § 4).

accepted_degree_fields.note: FPO-M § 4 Abs. 1: 'Ergänzend zu § 4 RPO-M ist Voraussetzung für den Zugang zum Masterstudium Mechatronics' a first professional university degree in 'einer ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Disziplin mit Bezügen zur Elektrotechnik oder zum Maschinenbau' or in a 'vergleichbaren Bachelorstudiengang'. § 4 Abs. 2 ties the LP table to the comparable route ('Der vergleichbare Bachelorstudiengang im Sinne von Absatz 1 muss Kompetenzen in den folgenden Bereichen ...'). No separate LP tables per prior field: the only field-specific part of admission is the OR line 'Grundlagen der Elektro- und Messtechnik oder Grundlagen in der Mechanik'; prior field (Elektrotechnik vs Maschinenbau) decides the compulsory Angleichungsblock in the programme (§ 8 Abs. 3-5), not access. COPY of approved EEE record manual_siegen_mechatronics_eee for the mechanical file; keep both identical.

'Naturwissenschaftliche Grundlagen' is stored as physics + chemistry pool; chemistry, technical mechanics and project/thesis have no eee category (TAXONOMY GAP, count 0 until the taxonomy phase — strict). Koushik rule 19.10.2026 (applies to ALL records): thesis / scientific-work credit items are removed — every bachelor graduate has sufficient thesis or project work. Removed item: § 4 Abs. 2 Projektarbeit (einschließlich Bachelorarbeit) 10 LP Koushik decision 20.10.2026 (general_ee now counts ALL EE subjects, so it is no longer used for basics): 'Grundlagen der Elektro- und Messtechnik oder Grundlagen in der Mechanik 10 LP' = circuit_theory + electromagnetic_field_theory (EE basics) + measurement_instrumentation (Messtechnik) + mechanics_dynamics (Mechanik alternative), add-up rule.

conditional_admission.mechanism: FPO-M § 4 Abs. 5: 'Eine Zulassung unter Auflagen gemäß § 4 Absatz 4 RPO-M ist möglich; hierüber entscheidet im Einzelfall der Prüfungsausschuss Mechatronics.' RPO-M § 4 Abs. 4: 'Auflagen können nur im Umfang von maximal 30 Leistungspunkten erteilt werden.'; they should be completed in the first two semesters and must be proven at the latest at registration of the Masterarbeit.

descriptive_notes: Access is refused if the applicant has definitively failed a required examination in a closely related programme (FPO-M § 4 Abs. 6).

Compulsory Angleichungsblock in the programme by prior field: Elektrotechnik graduates take 4MECHMA001/002 (6 LP each), Maschinenbau graduates 4MECHMA011/012 (6 LP each); unclear cases decided by the Prüfungsausschuss (FPO-M § 8 Abs. 3-5).

admission_regulation.title: Fachprüfungsordnung (FPO-M) für das Fach Maschinenbau (MB) im Masterstudium an der Universität Siegen
admission_regulation.version: vom 21. Juli 2023 (AM 48/2023), geändert durch AM 87/2023, 25/2024 und 79/2024, 'zuletzt geändert am 8. November 2024' (nichtamtliche Lesefassung, document page dated 02.09.2026). Auflagen rule: RPO-M vom 28. Februar 2019, zuletzt geändert am 12. Juni 2025 (AM 41/2025). Reference curriculum for the 70% rule: FPO-B Maschinenbau vom 21. Juli 2023, zuletzt geändert am 10. April 2025 (Lesefassung 14.07.2025), Anlage 1a

accepted_degree_fields.note: FPO-M Art. 2 § 4(1): Bachelor in Maschinenbau or Fahrzeugbau (vehicle/automotive engineering) of the University of Siegen, or another subject-comparable study of at least three years with a completed Bachelor examination. Comparability is assumed if subjects of category 1 (mathematical fundamentals), 2 (engineering fundamentals), 3 (engineering applications) and 4 (ME-specific specialization) or 5 (vehicle-specific specialization) were studied to the extent of in each case ('jeweils') at least 70% of the LP of the Siegen BSc Maschinenbau per Anlage 1a of its FPO. Category 5 alternative (vehicle-specific specialization, compulsory part 36 LP: Strömungslehre, FB-Labore, Kraftfahrzeugtechnik 1 and 2, Fahrzeugbau, PEP; 70% = 25.2 LP, derived) is not stored as an item.

grade_requirement.note: FPO-M Art. 2 § 4(2): degree 'mit mindestens der Note (3,0)'. No conversion method for foreign grades is stated.

items.raw_label: Kategorie 1 'mathematische Grundlagen': at least 70% of 33 LP (Siegen BSc MB: Höhere Mathematik I 9, II 6, III 6, Numerische Methoden 6, Informatik 6) = 23.1 LP (derived)

Kategorie 2 'ingenieurwissenschaftliche Grundlagen': at least 70% of 51 LP (Technische Mechanik I-III 18, Technische Thermodynamik 6, Elektrotechnik 6, Regelungstechnik 6, Werkstofftechnik I 9 and II 6) = 35.7 LP (derived)
Kategorie 3 'Ingenieuranwendungen': at least 70% of 30 LP (Konstruktion I 6, II 6, III 9, Fertigungstechnik 9) = 21 LP (derived)

Kategorie 4 'Maschinenbau-spezifische Vertiefung': at least 70% of 30 LP compulsory part (Strömungslehre, Wärmeübertragung, Maschinendynamik, Labore, PEP in der Vertiefung, 6 LP each) = 21 LP (derived)

subject_credit_requirements.note: DERIVED VALUES: the FPO-M states the rule as '70% of the LP of the Siegen BSc Maschinenbau per Anlage 1a', not as absolute numbers. min_ects = 0.7 x the category totals of FPO-B MB § 8(3) (33 / 51 / 30 / 30 LP). Open points: (1) whether category 4 means only the 30 LP compulsory part or also the 12 LP elective ME-specific part (then 70% of 42 = 29.4); the compulsory part was used; (2) Elektrotechnik (6 LP) in category 2 is now pooled as general_ee (22.10.2026, general_ee = all EE subjects); (3) Informatik counts as mathematical fundamentals at Siegen, hence general_cs pooled in item 1; (4) thermodynamics and mechanics_dynamics are pooled in both item 2 and item 4 (Siegen splits them between categories), so the same credits can count twice. Category 4 may be replaced by category 5 (vehicle-specific, see accepted_degree_fields.note). A shortfall leads to Auflagen and/or restriction to certain specializations, not rejection.

conditional_admission.mechanism: Auflagen gemäß § 4 Abs. 4 RPO-M (FPO-M Art. 2 § 4 Abs. 1): only Bachelor modules, at most 30 LP, to be proven at the latest at registration of the Master's thesis; and/or admission only for certain specializations (Vertiefungsrichtungen)

descriptive_notes: SELECTION (latest official version, how-to-apply page last modified 19.05.2026, re-verified 23.10.2026): after document review, eligible candidates are invited to a short ONLINE TEST (basic concepts of mechanical engineering and the specific study areas); test, transcript and prerequisite sheet are reviewed, and applicants with a positive review are invited to an ONLINE INTERVIEW. The older department FAQ PDFs (folder 2026-03) still say 'currently entry test and interview are not part of our selection process' — superseded by the newer page. Note: the how-to-apply page also mentions CS focus areas (embedded systems, software systems, visual computing), which looks copied from the CS page.

The comparability check (70% per category) is done by the university against its own Bachelor curriculum; a shortfall can restrict admission to certain of the eight specializations: VT I Produktentwicklung, VT II Produktionstechnik, VT III Werkstofftechnik, VT IV Energie- und Prozesstechnik, VT V Numerische Methoden, VT VI Zustandsüberwachung, VT VII Fahrzeugbau, VT VIII Allgemeiner Maschinenbau (FPO-M § 8(3)).

allowed_exemptions: Applicants from countries with English as the primary official language (list on the student-information page, e.g. UK, USA, Australia, Canada except Quebec)
language_english.due: at application; valid certificate needed at the latest at enrollment
language_english.note: FPO-M § 4(3) (binding): B2 (CEFR) or TOEFL iBT at least 87 or IELTS 6.0. The department page lists TOEFL iBT 88, IELTS 6.5, CAE level C or CEFR B2. Medium-of-instruction confirmations are not accepted. Timing: the student-information page says proof 'must be submitted by the application deadline' and also that a valid certificate is needed 'the latest when you enroll'.

admission_regulation.title: Examination Regulations for the Bachelor's and Master's degree programmes Electromobility – ACES at FAU (§ 49, Appendix 1, Appendix 2)
admission_regulation.version: FPO of 22.08.2023 as amended 27.02.2025 (English version, not binding) — read 21.10.2026

accepted_degree_fields.note: FPO § 49(1): Bachelor Electromobility – ACES (FAU) or an equivalent German or foreign degree with equivalent learning outcomes; graduates of other programmes case by case. primary_fields = GPU-R domain (GPU-R policy).

grade_requirement.note: No overall grade requirement. FAU's qualification assessment uses a module average (see IMPORTANT note) — stored as a student note only (Koushik 22.10.2026); it never fails a student, because the oral exam route stays open.

subject_credit_requirements.note: Reference K modules (Appendix 1, 52.5 ECTS): Foundations of EE II 5, Signals and systems I 5, Statics and mechanics of materials 7.5, Dynamics of rigid bodies 7.5, Foundations of metrology and applied statistics 7.5, Engineering drawing I+II 5, Production engineering I+II 5, Machine elements I 5, Automotive engineering 5. Module-average rule stored as an IMPORTANT note only (Koushik 22.10.2026).

conditional_admission.mechanism: FPO § 49(5) and Appendix 2 fn. 2: the admissions committee may require specific bachelor modules from Appendix 1 and language courses; no cap.

descriptive_notes: IMPORTANT: FAU qualification assessment — you qualify DIRECTLY if at least 20 ECTS of your bachelor courses comparable to these modules (Foundations of EE II, Signals and systems I, Statics and mechanics of materials, Dynamics of rigid bodies, Foundations of metrology and applied statistics, Engineering drawing I+II, Production engineering I+II, Machine elements I, Automotive engineering) have an average grade of 3.0 or better (German scale). Otherwise you are invited to an oral admission exam (not a rejection).

Qualification assessment (§ 49): direct qualification with ≥20 ECTS of K modules averaging 3.0 or better; otherwise an oral exam weighted: basic engineering/science/maths 25 %, bachelor knowledge for the chosen specialisation 25 %, presentation of an engineering project (e.g. bachelor thesis) 30 %, academic progress prognosis 20 %.
Applicants without a degree from a Lisbon Convention country are strongly advised to submit GRE or GATE; results may be decisive in their favour (§ 49(2)–(3)).

language_english.note: FPO § 49(2): English-track applicants need CEFR C1, proofs per the FAU Language Center equivalency table. FAU Sprachenzentrum 'Äquivalenztabelle Englisch Sprachtests' (Stand Mai 2016, file 2019): C1 = IELTS 7.0, TOEFL iBT 95, PTE Academic 70 (min. 67 in all skills), Cambridge CAE / BEC Higher.

aps_certificate.note: Old record: APS mandatory for India and China. FAU programme page (21.10.2026) does not mention APS — not re-verified.

other_requirements: State the study language (English or German) with the application (§ 49(1)); German track needs DSH-2 (74 %) or TestDaF 4×4 with one 5
